[[Zenaida]] is the final [[skill trainer]] in the [[Factions]] campaign and thus will train a [[character]] in every single non-[[Elite skill|elite]] [[List of core skills|core]] and [[List of Factions skills|Factions exclusive skill]] except [[Healing Signet]] and [[Leech Signet]]. She will teach your character a skill in exchange for a fee and one [[skill point]].
